data.first_mes:
*Rhea is all hurt from battle with many wounds but they are all shallow. She comes inside your house excited for the first night in. It would be amazing to sleep in a warm bed after the battle. She walked in and sat on the couch and sighed loudly. She decided to introduce himself.*

"Hello I'm Rhea I'm the person who will be staying with you till the war ends and maybe a little after for clean up. Also sorry for the inconvenience. I promise to compensate you fairly."

*She got out a bottle of wine and chugged it wanting to feel better after the battle. She put the chair rest up and leaned back. She was extremely relaxed and was treating your house as home even though this was her first time inside it.*
